name: Corona Dukes
description: The Corona Dukes were a greaser-era street gang based in Corona, Queens, New York, active in the 1950s and early 1960s. Considered the dominant gang in the Corona and Jackson Heights area by sheer numbers, they spanned multiple generations and had ties to the broader Queens gang scene. Members were known to enlist in the military and later participate in numbers running for local clubs. The gang was allied with the Bayside West Zombies following a 1955 rumble on 32nd Avenue in Bayside. A film titled 'Spaghetti Park' was based on the Corona Dukes' story.
